text: The accepted test loads in-content/common.css first when it is in the discovered list so dependent --in-content variables can resolve. Each stylesheet load either processes its rules or records a loading assertion failure; both paths resolve and remove listeners, letting the overall test complete before console-error checks. Keep load failure, parse warnings and prerequisite CSS ordering separate when maintaining this test. This inspected contract does not prove all stylesheet dependencies are satisfied. This is source/test-code inspection only. Full Bug 1935198 context and review discovery remain pending because browser reading is stopped. title: CSS static test load order and load errors are distinct from parser warnings
